enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Move arm under pillow. Move leg. Turn again. Open eyes. Close eyes. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, using the toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Swing legs to floor. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Use toilet. Flush toilet. Wash hands. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Turn off tap. Dry face with towel. Turn off bathroom light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast with toast and kettle-boiled tea
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Turn on kettle. Wait for toast. Butter toast. Pour tea into cup. Sit at table. Eat toast. Drink tea. Finish breakfast. Clean up dishes. Rinse cup and plate. Place in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Place laptop into bag. Place notebook into bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk to office building. Enter building. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails, and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Log in. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone calls. Coordinate program details. Meet with partner organization. Discuss project. Take notes. Return to desk. Prepare documents. Print materials. Organize files. Attend meeting. Speak in meeting. Listen in meeting.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to nearby cafe. Enter cafe. Order food. Pay. Wait for food. Receive food. Sit at table. Eat food. Drink water. Wipe mouth. Throw trash. Check phone. Walk back to office. Enter office. Sit at desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning program logistics, preparing materials, and following up with volunteers
enriched_activities.desc: Sit at desk. Open laptop. Open program plan document. Edit document. Make phone calls to volunteers. Send emails. Follow up with volunteers. Prepare materials. Print flyers. Assemble packets. Organize supplies. Attend meeting. Take notes. Update schedule. Coordinate with team. Review budget. Submit report. Leave office.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit. Put on headphones. Play music. Ride bus. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter apartment. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing out of work clothes into comfortable home clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Take off work shirt. Take off pants. Take off socks. Open drawer. Take out t-shirt. Put on t-shirt. Take out sweatpants. Put on sweatpants. Hang up work clothes. Close drawer. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner on the induction cooker and eating it
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place pan on induction cooker. Turn on induction cooker. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Turn off induction cooker. Transfer food to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Finish eating.

enriched_activities.activity: Cleaning up the dishes and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up plates. Scrape food into trash. Rinse plates. Open dishwasher. Load plates into dishwasher. Load cups. Load utensils. Add detergent. Close dishwasher. Press start button. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Scrub pans. Rinse pans. Wipe counter with cloth. Rinse sink. Turn off kitchen light. Walk out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Put feet on coffee table. Change channel again. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a hot shower after the water-heater peak window
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on bathroom light. Turn on water heater. Wait for hot water. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Turn off water heater. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and browsing the phone while winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Open social media. Scroll. Like posts. Comment. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel. Pick up phone again. Check email. Put down phone. Watch TV. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal admin and checking tomorrow's program schedule
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open computer. Log in. Open browser. Check bank account. Pay bills. Open calendar. Check tomorrow's schedule. Make notes. Close browser. Open email. Reply to personal emails. Close email. Shut down computer. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting ready for bed and sleeping
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Brush teeth. Use toilet. Wash face. Walk to bedroom. Take off clothes. Put on pajamas. Turn on fan. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.
